title: A point lies in the quasi-DM locus exactly when its automorphism group is locally quasi-finite
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a point of an algebraic stack lies in the DM locus exactly when its automorphism group space is unramified over the residue field, and in the quasi-DM locus exactly when that group is locally quasi-finite (author lemma at source lines 4816-4827, label lemma-points-DM-locus). The proof (source lines 4829-4888) constructs the maximal open subscheme of a smooth presentation over which the automorphism group space is locally quasi-finite, descends it through the presentation groupoid to the quasi-DM locus, proves maximality, and identifies the pointwise condition after a field extension, with the unramified case by the identical method (proof lines 4830-4887). The descent of the maximal open subscheme and the pointwise identification are the content. H3.
